bullets.text: Wayve Raises $1.2B - **Wayve** secures major funding from **Nvidia**, **Uber**, and automakers for self-driving tech.
Age Verification Rollout Delayed - **Discord** postpones global age verification amid user backlash.
Apple's Age Verification Tools - **Apple** launches age verification features to comply with new laws globally.
Samsung's Galaxy S26 Launch - Anticipation builds as **Samsung** prepares to unveil the **Galaxy S26** series.
Uber Expands into Parking - **Uber** acquires **SpotHero** to enhance parking reservation services.
YouTube Premium Lite Enhancements - **YouTube** adds background play and downloads to its Premium Lite plan.
Nvidia Challenger Raises $500M - **MatX**, an AI chip startup, secures funding to compete with **Nvidia**.
Google's Clean Energy Initiative - **Google** announces a massive clean energy deal for its new data center.
